content: {"like":["Values high-quality, well-crafted adaptations and classic cinema; appreciates detailed extras such as documentaries, articles, and behind‑the‑scenes content; enjoys films that maintain relevance over time and offer atmospheric storytelling; favors well‑cast performances and original or high‑resolution releases; seeks special editions with added value like interviews and special features."],"dislike":["Dislikes technical or packaging issues that affect viewing experience, such as poor DVD quality, hard‑to‑read silent films, or misaligned dialogue panels; is critical of subpar acting or weak scripts; avoids releases with low visual or audio fidelity; rejects overly dated or poorly preserved editions; is averse to presentations that alter the original aspect ratio or add unnecessary borders."]}
